tasks.short: Investigate public-water conflicts, recommend alternatives, update participants and prepare draft orders.

actual relevant records

actual authorized participant destinations

loop.purpose: Draft factual progress prose from actual status
loop.input: actual checked status, known uncertainties and authorized recipients
loop.output: source-linked progress update without invented decisions or deadlines
loop.check: Hydrologist checks meaning, omitted uncertainty, confidentiality and implications of completed versus pending actions
loop.stop: Unclear actual status or two failed revisions returns text to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Try native status fields first; contested progress qualifications require semantic checks

steps.what: Prepare draft orders from actual chosen alternatives and checked case facts
inputs: actual recommendations, reasons and checked investigation progress
actual checked investigation facts, statements and unresolved conflicts
actual current order form and scope
outputs: complete nonissued draft orders with actual qualifications

loop.purpose: Draft nonissued order prose from actual human-chosen recommendations
loop.input: actual case facts, chosen alternatives, scope and current form
loop.output: complete source-linked draft orders with unresolved legal questions explicit
loop.check: Hydrologist checks actual meaning, omitted case conditions and invented findings, powers or obligations
loop.stop: Unsupported obligation or two failed revisions returns affected clauses to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native order clauses first; case-specific reasons and qualifications need semantic drafting checks

steps.what: Complete and check final progress updates and internal draft orders against actual case evidence

outputs: exact final participant update release approval

inputs: checked saved internal draft orders and exact final participant updates with destinations
exact final participant update release approval
outputs: actual participant progress updates sent
